Our most directly relevant past performance aligns to (i) grid-tied solar PV delivery and (ii) execution within operational public-sector healthcare environments.

Solar PV / renewable energy experience: We have delivered multiple “Solar Energy deployment” contracts, including a PKR 171M engagement completed in 10 months (2024) [CAP-032], a Provincial Government solar deployment valued at PKR 31M delivered over 33 months (completed 2024) [CAP-008], and a Federal Government solar deployment valued at PKR 34M delivered over 20 months (completed 2020) [CAP-020]. We have also executed an additional solar deployment valued at PKR 42M over 13 months (completed 2022) [CAP-044]. These references evidence our ability to manage end-to-end delivery on schedule and budget across government and multi-stakeholder environments [CAP-008][CAP-020][CAP-032][CAP-044].

Public hospital / healthcare environment experience: We have delivered Hospital IT deployments for Federal Government (PKR 182M, 15 months, completed 2020) [CAP-042] and Provincial Government (PKR 66M, 28 months, completed 2023) [CAP-018], demonstrating controlled execution in sensitive hospital operations and coordination with public-sector counterparts [CAP-042][CAP-018].

Quality and project governance: Our library evidences delivery under ISO 9001 on an international engagement (PKR 64M, 33 months, completed 2022) [CAP-030]. We also evidence PMP-certified delivery capability through prior projects carrying PMP credentialing (e.g., PKR 137M, 26 months; PKR 142M, 21 months) [CAP-005][CAP-027]. Our library does not yet evidence DISCO net-metering liaisoning, SCADA central dashboards, Tier-1 module efficiency/warranty particulars, or three-year O&M performance guarantees; we will address these mandatory requirements through named OEM/SCADA partnerships and by submitting project-specific O&M and performance-guarantee commitments in our technical proposal.
